UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile storing display preferences and active platform.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in call UI.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was updated.

CallHistoryEntry.title: CallHistoryEntry
CallHistoryEntry.description: Private user call history record with room code, peer details, and duration.

peerName.description: Display name of the remote participant.

direction.description: Whether the user hosted or joined the call.

status.description: Final outcome of the call session.

CallRoom.title: CallRoom
CallRoom.description: Cross-platform WebRTC signaling room for SDP offer/answer and ICE candidate exchange between Android and iOS.

hostUid.description: Firebase UID of the room creator.

guestUid.description: Firebase UID of the joining participant.

guestName.description: Display name of the joining participant.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the signaling room.

offerSdp.description: WebRTC SDP offer string created by host.

answerSdp.description: WebRTC SDP answer string created by guest.

callerCandidates.description: Bounded list (max 40) of host ICE candidate maps.

calleeCandidates.description: Bounded list (max 40) of guest ICE candidate maps.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when room was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document owned by userId.

/calls/{roomId}.description: Cross-platform WebRTC signaling room keyed by room code.
